Update a dragmapr widget in place

Source: R/widget.R
updateDragmapr.Rd

Update a dragmapr widget in place

Usage

updateDragmapr(session, outputId, ...)

Arguments

session

Shiny session.

outputId

Widget output id.

...

Live updates to apply. Display options use the R API, for example show_origin_outlines or map_background. The composition field selected_feature can also be updated; pass NULL or "" to clear the current selection. Use remove_features = c(...) to remove one or more feature ids from the live widget, or delete_selected = TRUE to remove the current selection.

Value

Invisibly returns the sent message.
